info.title: Horizon Pulse
info.description: Pay-per-call APIs for AI agents via x402 on Base: web fetch, HTTP proxy, page extract, and crypto market data. Ten x402 v2 routes (USDC on Base mainnet, eip155:8453; Coinbase CDP facilitator): /api/fetch ($0.02 clean text/markdown), /api/http ($0.01 SSRF-safe HTTP proxy, GET|POST), /api/extract ($0.015 structured page fields, GET|POST), /api/x402-check ($0.01 x402 endpoint audit), and six crypto routes (pulse, signals, yield, portfolio, gas, funding).

get.description: $0.01 USDC x402. Sends one unpaid probe (never pays or signs) to a public x402 endpoint and reports: HTTP status, whether it is a valid x402 challenge, x402 version (v1/v2), decoded accepts (network, asset, price, payTo), payTo type via eth_getCode on Base/Ethereum (EOA vs contract), discovery-metadata hints, and pass/warn/fail checks. SSRF-safe (private/localhost blocked at every redirect hop), 3 redirects, 8s timeout. Unreachable targets return 502/504 and are not charged.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the x402 endpoint to audit

400.description: Missing, bad, or blocked URL / method (not charged)

502.description: Target unreachable or too many redirects (not charged)
